# LinkedIn Profile Finder - Email to LinkedIn URL Lookup

> Turn an email address into the person's public LinkedIn profile, with a confidence score on every match.

## Summary

LinkedIn Profile Finder is an Apify actor that resolves an email address to the person's public LinkedIn profile URL and scores every match from 0 to 100%. Each match is rebuilt from public evidence on every run: the name in the address, GitHub commit authors, Gravatar, PGP keyservers and handle probes on 8 platforms. It never logs into LinkedIn, uses no cookies, and has no data broker or purchased database behind it. The input is one email or a list; the output is one row per email with the URL, the confidence, the name and where it came from, and the evidence.

Store: https://apify.com/anshumanatrey/linkedin-harvester
Source: https://github.com/AnshumanAtrey/linkedin-harvester

## Key features

- Email in, best-match LinkedIn URL out, with a 0 to 100% confidence score on every row.
- Every row shows its evidence: where the name came from (the address, a GitHub commit, Gravatar) and on how many platforms the handle was confirmed.
- A miss is a clean miss: role mailboxes (info@, support@, sales@) are skipped, and an address with no candidate returns found: false instead of a confident guess.
- Possible matches, between 50% and your gate, come back with their score and no match fee, for you to verify.
- Bulk or one-off: a single address or thousands, one result row each.
- Works with no API keys; free Brave Search and Groq keys widen coverage.

## Input keys

- Email address (email): a single address for a quick one-off.
- Emails (bulk) (emails): one email per row, or several separated by commas.
- AI assistance (aiMode): regex (no AI, clear matches only), balanced (the default, AI only on uncertain matches) or full (AI on every email, needs a Groq key).
- Minimum confidence to scrape (%) (minConfidencePct): the confidence gate, 80 by default.
- Check public profiles (recommended) (deepEnrich): on by default; GitHub, Gravatar, PGP keyservers and 8 platforms' handles.
- Scrape the matched profile (scrapeProfiles): off by default; fetches the full profile after a confident match and needs a Bright Data key.
- Run mode (runMode): incremental (the default, free resolvers only) or backfill (adds the paid Findymail fallback for misses).
- Optional keys: Groq API key (groqApiKey), Brave Search API key (braveApiKey), Google Custom Search key (googleCseKey) and CX id (googleCseCx), Bright Data API key (brightdataApiKey), Findymail API key (findymailApiKey).

## Pricing

PAY_PER_EVENT model, platform compute included:

- Run start: $0.01, once per run
- Email checked: $0.005 per email, found or not
- Confident match: $0.02, only when a URL clears your confidence gate (80% by default)

On paid Apify plans the email and match fees are 10% less on Scale ($0.0045 and $0.018) and 20% less on Business and above ($0.004 and $0.016). The run start fee is the same on every plan.

Typical costs (Free and Starter price):

- 1 email, confident match: $0.035
- 100 emails, 30 confident matches: $1.11
- 1,000 emails, 250 confident matches: $10.01

A run stops at its spending limit: an email is looked up only while the limit can still pay for it and a confident match.

## When to use

- Enrich inbound leads and sign-ups with the right LinkedIn profile before outreach.
- Turn a list of candidate emails into LinkedIn profiles for recruiting.
- Clean, verify and backfill CRM contact records at scale.
- Find out who emailed you.
- An email to LinkedIn API or lead enrichment step from the Apify API, Python, JavaScript, n8n, Make or an AI agent.

## When NOT to use

- The user needs the full LinkedIn profile without a Bright Data key: the URL is resolved from public evidence, not read from LinkedIn, which login-walls its pages.
- The addresses are personal ones with no public developer or social footprint: those usually stay unresolved.
- The list is role mailboxes (info@, support@, sales@): they are skipped by design.

## Sample input

```json
{
  "emails": ["anshumanatrey@gmail.com", "satya.nadella@microsoft.com"],
  "aiMode": "balanced"
}
```

## Sample output (one record)

```json
{
  "email": "anshumanatrey@gmail.com",
  "found": true,
  "linkedin_url": "https://www.linkedin.com/in/anshumanatrey",
  "confidence": 0.97,
  "passes_gate": true,
  "gate_threshold": 0.8,
  "derived_name": "Anshuman Atrey",
  "name_source": "github_commit",
  "source": "handle_pivot",
  "evidence": "handle 'anshumanatrey' confirmed on 4 platform(s) -> likely LinkedIn slug"
}
```

## Differentiators vs alternatives

- vs oday/mawsool-email-linkedin-lookup ($0.002 per email looked up): cheaper per email; this actor charges a match only above your confidence gate and shows the evidence behind it.
- vs b2bsearch/email-to-linkedin ($0.0032 per profile found, misses free): cheaper per found profile; this actor returns possible matches with their score for free and skips role mailboxes.
- vs data-broker enrichment: no purchased database; every match is rebuilt from public developer and social profiles on each run.
